svg.title: Figure 8: Overlays
svg.text: Containers that float above a page. Each is drawn over a dimmed page.
Opens at its button, or at the cursor
An icon on every item; the destructive
item is last, after a divider, in Error ink.
Bottom of the window; fades out.
One line saying what is lost.
Swaps in for the row itself;
Not in the page's own markup.
ProfileAvatar opens ProfilePopover (MudPopover, page not dimmed) holding a ProfileCard
Click away or Escape closes it.
Agents only, never the Human's card.
Model and Effort by cached display name;
uncached: the stored id, or "Agent default"
and "Model default". Never probes on open.
